anonymity_rule: Do not infer or seek actor identities, model families, effort levels, earlier drafts, or earlier review outcomes. Review only the supplied evidence.
learner_baseline: The learner is an ungrounded, unembodied 1.2B model. Assume zero bankable semantics, grammar, discourse, world knowledge, identity grounding, common sense, interface convention, or human childhood experience.

lesson_context.point: Greeting, self-identification, affirmative and negative identity, Who, OR, and meeting reciprocity, with every tested form modeled locally immediately before its controlled gate.
lesson_context.world_objective: The names Ninereeds, Taro, Emma, Bob, and Errol remain stable across the lesson.
lesson_context.structural_exception: L000 is the sole staged nonlexical exception and has zero vocabulary items.

review_requirements: Inspect every modeled turn, base and reserve exercise, mixed order, story turn, comprehension demonstration/test, intervention, replay, alarm, budget, and asset binding.
Verify execution_sequence exhaustively interleaves every local model with its controlled gate and prevents a monolithic front-loaded presentation.
Verify nonverbal checks bind exact story turns, show the complete option pair, and expose the replay/options/correct-option action sequence before scoring.

Verify TRAIN_MORE reserves are additional Point-safe prompts, TRAIN_LONGER has deterministic release and precedence, and REPLAY_LESSON has unambiguous reset, aggregation, post-replay mastery, and finish rules.
Judge pixels, learner-facing language, identity safety, story coherence, intervention totality, and all terminal paths against the zero-convention baseline.
Return revise for any non-waterproof defect with exact owning-stage repair; do not rewrite the lesson.
output_contract: Write exactly one JSON file matching ninereeds_sol_assembly_review_v1. Set lesson_sha256 to candidate_sha256 and visual_necessity explicitly.
